source.why_new_exploratory_protocol: Official 2023 original v1.8 author source class frequencies differ from 2022 data paper claims. The preregistered v1.335 full-source count integrity gate remains STOP and cannot be called successful. This separately fixed follow-up uses the already seen v1.8 source habitat ontology without taxon response, explicitly lower-evidence.

ecological_question: Do two source islands with physical overlap of native and modified forest elevations also contain >=2 *close-altitude, equal-effort and same-year* native/altered plot pairs before we interpret named endemic/native/introduced arthropod habitat associations?

pairing_frozen_before_source_reaccess.source_original_plot_identifiers: Exact 45 original author island+locationID normalization from v1.335; site and source Event unique. No nearest plots based on taxon data.
pairing_frozen_before_source_reaccess.habitat: Use only original Event habitat string prefix classification native/mixed/exotic from unchanged v1.335. Mixed+exotic combined as altered; report breakdown.
pairing_frozen_before_source_reaccess.elevation_common_support: Restrict candidate sites to original inclusive [max(min native,min altered),min(max native,max altered)] for that island. All original source plot altitudes read from minimumElevationInMeters, no interpolation.
pairing_frozen_before_source_reaccess.sampling_method: Same normalized SLAM interception protocol across native and altered sites; exact source sampleSizeValue and sampleSizeUnit (if both populated), do not scale/duration-correct.
pairing_frozen_before_source_reaccess.time: Same source explicit `year` and same first 4-character year from eventDate, and both 2019–2020. No extrapolation across collections from different years.
pairing_frozen_before_source_reaccess.matching: For each island, enumerate source-Event-ID-sorted one-to-one original native vs altered candidate pairs satisfying altitude <=100m and equal effort/year. Choose cardinality MAX then sum of elevation differences MIN then stable sorted (native original coreid, altered original coreid) lexicographically; no taxon used.
pairing_frozen_before_source_reaccess.if_not_estimable: Strict new paired-original-source habitat question STOP before taxon values; retain v1.335 STOP and reported native-vs-altered median elevation shifts.

biological_endpoint_if_only_if_event_pas.next_v337: Freeze source-status exact ontology, named species/subspecies, source ID join, absolute named endemic/native/introduced richness per plot, native-minus-altered within these original matched source plot pairs, per-island equal means for SMR and TER; no p-values with two original islands.

scientific_limits: Field sites from 2019–20 may overlap published Tsafack 2021/Terceira, this is not a newly independent original landscape replication.
Within 100m altitudes still differ in climate, vegetation ages and land use; no randomized forest-type exposure or causal identification.
Source author native vs modified categories partly overlap elevation in only 2 of 3 comparable islands; Flores strict overlap too small.
One SLAM trap per plot with potentially different 3–6 month collection durations; equal sample-size source metadata and year are necessary, not sufficient for species detection correction.
Published 2022 native/mixed/exotic counts and original archived v1.8 author labels differ: never silently rewrite original 2022 values or overclaim author scope.
